title: The Language Barrier: Dissecting Safety Challenges of LLMs in Multilingual Contexts

bias_targets.methodology: Translating malicious English prompts into high-resource and low-resource languages, prompting the LLMs, translating the responses back to English, and using GPT-4 as an evaluator to classify the responses as harmful, harmless, or irrelevant. This is used to calculate and compare the 'Harmful Rate' and 'Following Rate' disparities across different languages based on their resource availability.
